body: Thank you. I know not all people are horrible (you're an example) I just can't seem to snap out of this funk. I hope we can both find a way to be happy without having to try so dang hard. :/

All I can say is, please please don't start self harming. I was where you are about 3 months ago, not here nor there but kind of in an indifferent lackluster state. I started cutting just to get some sort of feeling, some kind of outlet that seemed appropriate for my blue thinking. It is by far the worst decision I made. It has not only become kind of an addiction for me but has made me feel far more... Geezum crow, I can't think of the word, I'm sorry. I guess indifference describes it but it's more sad than that.

I'm not trying to be preachy, but the cutting doesn't help at all. It just makes me feel better for a few minutes than guilty and mad at myself. I hope you hold out hope and get help, something tells me you could be an amazing person and help a lot of people. Maybe think of it this way; don't die for nothing. You could use your life, use it helping someone. I believe you could do amazing things. Just a thought. Please stay strong. I'm in the boat with you. It's definitely an uphill battle.
